privacyChangesBody: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make any material changes, we will notify you through the app or by other means so you can review the changes before they take effect.
privacyChildrenBody: Our service is not directed to individuals under the age of 16, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) as applicable in Romania and across the EU. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.
privacyContactBody: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
privacyCorePrincipleBody: The most important thing to know is that we, the developers of **HealthWallet.me**, do not collect, store, or have access to any of your personal or health information. Our app operates entirely on your device.
privacyDeletion: Deletion: You can delete your information at any time from within the app. Deleting the app from your device will also permanently delete all data it has stored.
privacyDescription: is a simple, secure tool designed to help you organize your health records with ease, directly on your device. This policy explains our commitment to your privacy: we do not collect your data, and we do not track you. You are in complete control.
privacyDoNotCollectIntro: To be perfectly clear, our app is intentionally built to avoid accessing your personal data. We **do not** collect, store, link, or process any information that can be tied to you.
privacyFastenDirectDownload: Direct-to-Device Download: When you authorize the connection, your health records are downloaded **directly from your FastenHealth OnPrem instance to your device**. Our app is only a conduit; your data never passes through our servers.
privacyFastenIntro: Our app allows you to consolidate your health records by connecting to **FastenHealth OnPrem**, a transparent, open-source platform.
privacyFastenOpenSource: Open-Source and On-Premises: FastenHealth OnPrem is open-source software that you or a trusted entity controls. This provides an exceptional level of privacy.
privacyHealthInformation: Health Information: Any health records, medical conditions, medications, or other data you import remain yours alone. We cannot access them.
privacyImportingIntro: You can add health documents (such as PDFs of lab results or clinic summaries) directly into the app using standard mobile operating system features:
privacyIntro: Your privacy is our highest priority.
privacyLocalProcessing: Once a document is imported, the app processes it locally on your device in the background. It structures the information according to the **HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources)** standard to make it useful and organized. This entire process happens on your device; the document and the structured data never leave it.
privacyNoCloudProcessing: ✅ No Cloud Processing: All calculations, data organization, and other functions happen locally on your phone or tablet.
privacyNoCrossReferencing: No Cross-Referencing: The app operates in isolation. It **does not** scan, index, or cross-reference your health data with any other personal information on your phone (like your contacts list, name, or phone number). Its only job is to organize the records you provide to it.
privacyNoDeveloperAccess: ✅ No Developer Access: We cannot see, access, or export your data. It is never sent to our servers.
privacyNoOtherUse: We do not use your information for advertising, research, or any other purpose.
privacyPersonalIdentifiers: Personal Identifiers: We do not access or store your name, email address, phone number, contacts, or any other personal account information from your device.
privacyScanning: Scanning: Using your device's camera to scan a physical document from within the app.
privacyShareActionSheet: Share Action Sheet: Selecting a file from another app (like your email, photos, or file manager) and "sharing" it directly to **HealthWallet.me**.
privacySharing: Sharing: We do not and cannot share your data with anyone because we don't have it. If you choose to export or share your data from the app, you are in complete control of where it goes.
privacyStorage: Storage: All your data is stored in the app's secure, sandboxed storage on your device. It is as secure as your device itself. We strongly recommend you protect your device with a passcode, Face ID, or other biometric security.
privacyUsageAnalytics: Usage Analytics: We do not track how you use the app, which buttons you tap, or how long you spend on certain screens.
privacyUsageDisplaying: Displaying your health records, lab results, and medication history to you.
privacyUsageIntro: Since all your data resides on your device, it is only "used" by the app to help you organize and view your records. This includes:
privacyUsageProcessing: Processing and structuring imported or scanned documents.
privacyYouAreInControl: ✅ You Are in Control: Your information is stored securely within the app's private storage on your device, which only you can access.
privacyYouManageIntro: The only data processed by the app is the health information **you choose to import** into it. This can be done in the following ways:
